headlines.title: OpenAI releases new model that it says triggered internal security measures
headlines.description: The AI giant says its model better follows user intent and crosses a frontier for cybersecurity capabilities and could be artificial general intelligence.

headlines.title: Anger over planned AI data center drives Missouri city’s voters to recall council member
headlines.description: Residents of Independence also voted out two City Council members who supported data centers during a general election in April.

headlines.title: Two trapped workers pulled alive from Nepal tunnel more than a week after deadly floods
headlines.description: Two workers in Nepal were pulled out alive from a hydropower tunnel on Friday, some nine days after devastating floods swept the Himalayan region and left thousands of people missing.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy jury risks mistrial on 7th day of deliberations after 2 deadlock notes
headlines.description: Lindsay Clancy’s defense team filed a motion to Judge William Sullivan on Friday asking that there be no more sidebars for the remainder of the triple-murder trial, and that all further proceedings be handled in open court.

headlines.title: Hundreds of teens swarm Colorado shopping center for so-called ‘takeover’
headlines.description: Hundreds of teens swarmed a shopping center in Colorado in what’s been dubbed a ‘‘takeover.’ It’s part of a growing trend where streets and businesses are overrun, usually organized on social media. NBC News' Steve Patterson reports.

headlines.title: Mamdani announces ban on AI for young students in NYC public schools
headlines.description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani announced a one-year ban on artificial intelligence for students from 2-K through 8th grade in public schools. NBC News' Tyler Kingkade reports.

headlines.title: Social media is supercharging the decades-old collectible craze
headlines.description: Children of the 80s and 90s probably remember the frenzy to collect the latest fad toy of the year, but far from dying out in our digital age, collectibles are hotter, and more valuable, than ever. NBC News' Yasmin Vossoughian reports.

headlines.title: What Tim Cook’s Departure Means for the Future of Apple
headlines.description: It’s a new era at Apple as Tim Cook’s time as CEO officially comes to an end after 15 years. Now all eyes are on his replacement John Ternus and his ability to see new and innovative ideas at the tech giant. NBC’s Savannah Sellers reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: How Bailey the Beagle Was Genetically Edited to Be Allergy-Free
headlines.description: Bailey the beagle is one of only 2 puppies that has been genetically engineered in a lab to be completely allergy free. Her human, Matt Walker, is a geneticist who grew up allergic to dogs his whole life and he hopes gene editing technology can help other breeds find homes. NBC’s Gadi Schwartz reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: How New Tech is Sparking a Craze in Backyard Bird Feeders
headlines.description: Bird feeders have been around for ages but modern technology is attracting a lot of new interest. The newest products send you an alert after a winged visitor swings by for a meal, and using AI, the feeders can identify thousands of different species. NBC’s Joe Fryer reports for TODAY with a look at the growing number of families flocking to the hobby.

headlines.title: NASA administrator explains how Roman Telescope will change understanding of the universe
headlines.description: NBC News' Gadi Schwartz speaks with NASA administrator Jared Isaacman about the Nancy Grace Roman Telescope launch, the Artemis III launch in 2027, and SpaceX's new Louisiana Starbase.

headlines.title: Meet the humanoid robots cleaning homes for $30 an hour
headlines.description: These $30-an-hour humanoid robots are cleaning homes in San Francisco, tackling tasks like mopping floors, tidying rooms and cleaning kitchens. NBC News' Tom Llamas speaks with Tau Robotics CEO and co-founder Alexander Koch about how the robots work and the challenges of making them fully A.I. powered.
